test_debug_features: Internal loopback (MCR.LOOP=1) for fault isolation; SOUT internally drives SIN; modem outputs drive modem inputs.
Break, parity, overrun, framing error simulation through loopback + register manipulation.
FIFO reset bits (FCR.RX_FIFO_RESET, FCR.TX_FIFO_RESET) for in-chip BIST equivalent.
Complete LSR status reporting allows software self-test of all framing / error paths.
Master Reset (MR pin) sets a known reset state per Table I.

spec_provided_observability.name: LSR.DR
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Data Ready — character available in RBR / RX FIFO.

spec_provided_observability.name: LSR.RFE
spec_provided_observability.purpose: RX FIFO contains at least one error (FIFO mode).

spec_provided_observability.name: IIR
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Identifies highest-priority pending interrupt + FIFO-enabled status.

spec_provided_observability.name: MSR delta bits
spec_provided_observability.purpose: DCTS / DDSR / TERI / DDCD record modem-input transitions since last read.

interrupt_sources.trigger: RX data available or FIFO trigger level reached.
Character timeout — RX FIFO non-empty + no new char within 4 character times.

interrupt_request: INTR pin (active HIGH) is the OR of all enabled interrupt sources; IIR identifies the highest-priority pending source.
notes: Beyond Direct Test Mode (Vol 6 Part F) and HCI status/event APIs, the spec leaves SoC-internal scan/JTAG/BIST to the chip integrator. Bluetooth Qualification (Profile Tuning Suite, PTS) tests cover protocol-level conformance and interoperability — they consume DTM + HCI but do not extend the spec itself.

test_modes_high_speed_only.name: Test_J
test_modes_high_speed_only.purpose: Drive J-state continuously; verify driver levels.

test_modes_high_speed_only.name: Test_SE0_NAK
test_modes_high_speed_only.purpose: Drive SE0 and respond to IN with NAK.

test_modes_high_speed_only.name: Test_Packet
test_modes_high_speed_only.purpose: Transmit a defined test packet pattern.

test_modes_high_speed_only.name: Test_Force_Enable
test_modes_high_speed_only.purpose: Force a hub port enable for testing.

error_detection_mechanisms: CRC-5 on Token / SOF packets (covers ADDR + ENDP or FRAMENUM).
CRC-16 on Data packets (covers DATA field).
PID 4-bit + 4-bit complement provides single-bit-error detection on PID itself.
Bit-stuff violation (7 consecutive 1s without stuffed 0) flagged as error.
Timeout — no response within bus turn-around time.
False EOP detection — SE0 ≥ 2 bit times outside of expected EOP.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: Device attach detected by hub (D+ or D- pull-up sensed).
Both D+ and D- pulled to GND for SE0 ≥ 2 µs.

direct_test_mode_overview: Volume 6 Part F (Direct Test Mode) defines a test interface allowing a tester to drive the controller into a deterministic RF state (LE Test, LE Transmitter Test, LE Receiver Test, LE Test End) over either HCI or a 2-wire UART for production-line / certification testing. All 40 channels can be selected; LE 1M, LE 2M, LE Coded S=2, LE Coded S=8 are supported.

dtm_command_set.name: LE_TRANSMITTER_TEST
dtm_command_set.purpose: Start transmitter test on a given channel with a given packet pattern (PRBS9 / 11110000 / 10101010 / PRBS15 / all-1 / all-0 / 0000_1111 / 0101_0101) and length.

dtm_command_set.name: LE_RECEIVER_TEST
dtm_command_set.purpose: Start receiver test on a given channel; reports number of packets received.

dtm_command_set.name: LE_TEST_END
dtm_command_set.purpose: End the test; for receiver test returns packet count; for transmitter returns success only.

dtm_command_set.name: LE_ENHANCED_TRANSMITTER_TEST
dtm_command_set.purpose: Like LE_TRANSMITTER_TEST but parameterized by PHY (1M / 2M / Coded S=2 / Coded S=8) and modulation index (Standard / Stable).

dtm_command_set.name: LE_ENHANCED_RECEIVER_TEST
dtm_command_set.purpose: Like LE_RECEIVER_TEST with PHY + modulation-index selection.

dtm_command_set.name: LE_TRANSMITTER_TEST_v3
dtm_command_set.purpose: Adds antenna-switching pattern (CTE) for direction-finding test (BLE 5.1).

dtm_command_set.name: LE_RECEIVER_TEST_v3
dtm_command_set.purpose: Adds antenna-switching pattern for AoA test (BLE 5.1).

test_modes_high_speed_only_compat: Not applicable — BLE has no equivalent of USB 'HS test modes'; DTM is the standardized production-line test mechanism.
